description: Réseau AEP Complet - Tronçon de canalisation is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. A pipe segment is defined by a linear object between two nodes and supporting the same attributes. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "AEP Complete Network - Pipeline section" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Réseaux, canalisation, potable, aep, Spécifique, eau. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
